Range 30 feet

Targets 1 creature

Frequency once per day

Saving Throw Will

Duration 1 minute

The target must succeed at a Will save against your class DC or become fascinated with you for the duration and unable to willingly move more than 30 feet from you (on a critical failure, it also can't attack anyone but you while fascinated). Each round it takes damage from a source other than you, it may attempt a new save to end the effect. This is an emotion, incapacitation, and mental effect.
